title: Satellite imagery reveals increased activity at North Korean nuclear complex
snippet: RFA April 28, 2026 — High-resolution images from March to April show the Yongbyon facility being well-maintained; vehicles seen on April 15. Consistent water discharge from 5 MW reactor throughout 2026; occasional steam from Radiochemistry Lab; new high-rise residential buildings erected.
tag_reason: Provides additional April 15-28 observations of the same Yongbyon complex; cross-reinforces src-001 with multi-week temporal monitoring.
